title: Sound
summary: Every sound begins with a vibration. Discover how sound travels, what makes pitch and loudness, how instruments from the veena to the jal tarang make music, how we hear, and how to protect our ears.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Sound is energy carried by vibrations through a medium; understanding it helps us communicate, make music and protect our hearing.

factual: Why can't sound travel through a vacuum?
What decides the pitch and loudness of a sound?
conceptual: How do musical instruments control the pitch of their notes?
How do animals and ships use echoes to ‘see’ with sound?
debatable: Should festival loudspeakers and firecrackers face stricter noise limits?
Is noise pollution as serious as air pollution?
